tiktok_title: Bayi 1-6 bulan cukup 90-120 ml ASIP sekali minum. Cara hitung stok buat ditinggal kerja
first_comment: Kamu balik kerja pas bayimu umur berapa bulan? 👇
caption:
Setelah umur 4-5 minggu, sekali minum biasanya sekitar 90-120 ml. Sehari kira-kira 750 ml, dan jumlah ini nggak banyak berubah sampai 6 bulan (HSE Irlandia, La Leche League GB). Jadi stok ASIP nggak perlu ditambah tiap bulan.

Cara hitung buat ditinggal kerja: 750 ml dibagi 24 jam, kira-kira 30 ml per jam kamu pergi. Pergi 10 jam? Siapkan sekitar 300 ml, dibagi jadi 3 kali minum. Simpan juga beberapa kantong kecil 50-100 ml buat tambahan, biar nggak ada yang kebuang.

Ini angka kasar. Bayi beda-beda, jadi ikuti tanda lapar dan kenyangnya.

Bayimu sekali minum ASIP biasanya habis berapa ml?

Sumber: HSE Irlandia, La Leche League GB, Australian Breastfeeding Association, CDC

sources: HSE Ireland, How much breast milk to express (reviewed 18/02/2026): day 1 few drops to 5 ml (about 1 teaspoon), day 2 5-15 ml, day 3 15-30 ml per feed. first week full-term no more than 5-60 ml at a feed. after 4-5 weeks about 90-120 ml per feed and 700-900 ml a day. 1 to 6 months fed only breast milk about 750 ml a day. per feed = 750 divided by number of feeds. https://www2.hse.ie/babies-children/breastfeeding/expressing-pumping/how-much-breast-milk-express/

La Leche League GB, Expressing & Storing Milk: for babies older than one month a feed is approximately 60-120 ml. milk production peaks by about one month and stays relatively stable until around six months. average around 750-800 ml. https://laleche.org.uk/?p=1756

Australian Breastfeeding Association, Pump milk stash: store milk in small amounts (50-100 mL) so carers can offer what your baby needs and to reduce wastage. https://www.breastfeeding.asn.au/resources/pump-milk-stash

CDC, How Much and How Often to Breastfeed (reviewed 16 Apr 2026): babies take what they need and stop when full. follow hunger cues. https://www.cdc.gov/infant-toddler-nutrition/breastfeeding/how-much-and-how-often.html

CDC, Breast Milk Storage and Preparation (already used in w3n-asip-simpan): leftover milk from a feeding used within 2 hours. use oldest milk first. https://www.cdc.gov/breastfeeding/breast-milk-preparation-and-storage/handling-breastmilk.html
notes: Short format (4 slides). Sequel to w3n-asip-simpan. '30 ml per jam' is our arithmetic from HSE's 750 ml/day divided by 24 hours (31 ml), shown on the slide as the working, not presented as a guideline. '3 kali 100 ml' sits inside HSE's 90-120 ml per feed. Copy says 'sekali minum', never 'per botol'. the word botol is not used anywhere and the art shows only ASI bags and a small cup.
